contexts.text: Jacob vowed a vow () = ... to will that the Lord may provide; and, in the supreme sense, a state of Providence. Explained. AC 4091.
Where thou vowedst unto Me a vow () = what is holy. Explained.
All monks and nuns are there freed from their vows... in order that they may be led to choose a life... according to the interior wishes and desires of their love.
Those who had vowed perpetual virginity...
One may wish from the heart for a chaste marriage...
If there is a wish for more children.
Keep thy feasts, and perform thy vows () = to rejoice on account of His advent, and to worship Him then.
He swore to Jehovah, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob () = an irrevocable asseveration before the Lord.
To vow and sacrifice () = to worship...
